YAOGAN 13


YAOGAN 13 is no longer on orbit

  • Yaogan


NORAD ID: 37941
Int'l Code: 2011-072A
Launch date: November 29, 2011
Source: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Launch site: Taiyaun Space Center, China (TSC)
Decay date: 2025-02-22

YAOGAN 13 is a remote sensing satellite. The Yaogan series of satellites gather optical and radar reconnaissance imagery for Chinese military and intelligence agencies. Yaogan 13 may carry a synthetic aperture radar sensor to peer through clouds for all-weather, night-and-day image collection.
